structure: Part 4 read lines 3419 to 7053 of src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json in full: 83 consecutive country records (records 84 to 166 of the 250, in MDM id order), from Philippines (the) to Saint Martin (French part). Each record has the same shape: id and countryUUID (MDM-COUNTRY, DEFRA), ISONumeric, alpha2 and alpha3 (ISO-3166-3, 2024-06), independent, system, systemAlias, systemAlpha2, systemAlpha3, effectiveAlias, effectiveAlpha2, effectiveAlpha3, subDivisions and blocks. Covered: one claim per record with its effective and ISO codes, ISONumeric, independent and system; one claim per GBNAG_SPS_EX membership (14 countries) and one per country for its nameless block entries; one claim per subdivision (6 for France, 2 for Portugal); and slice-wide claims on the shared list metadata, id shape, null system aliases, unpadded ISO numerics, MDM id ordering, Togo's missing independent key and the French territories that appear both as subdivisions and as countries. No record in the slice has a non-null systemAlias, systemAlpha2 or systemAlpha3.

claims.statement: Every country record from Philippines (the) to Saint Martin (French part) gives its ISONumeric, alpha2 and alpha3 as objects with listId ISO-3166-3, listAgencyId ISO and listVersionId 2024-06.

claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:3419-3429 (country record 84, id and countryUUID; same shape in every record to line 7053)
claims.statement: Every country record in this slice has an id whose content is "gbnag-" followed by its countryUUID, both with schemeId MDM-COUNTRY and schemeAgencyId DEFRA.
claims.note: Checked across all 83 records with jq: no record's id content differs from gbnag- plus its countryUUID. Per-record UUIDs are not claimed one by one.

claims.statement: In every country record of this slice the effectiveAlpha2 and effectiveAlpha3 equal the ISO alpha2 and alpha3 values, and systemAlias, systemAlpha2 and systemAlpha3 are null, so no record here overrides its ISO name or codes for the gbnag system.
claims.note: Inferred from the field names: effective* equals alpha* wherever system* is null.

claims.statement: ISONumeric values are strings without leading zeros, so codes below 100 read as one or two digits: Andorra "20", Afghanistan "4", Albania "8", Algeria "12", Bahamas (the) "44", Belgium "56", Bosnia and Herzegovina "70", Belize "84" and Brunei Darussalam "96".

The records in this slice are in ascending order of their MDM id, not alphabetical order of name: Philippines (the) (gbnag-5202e059...) comes first and Saint Martin (French part) (gbnag-af2f0195...) last.
claims.note: Inferred from the id sequence; a caller that shows the list in name order must sort it.

claims.statement: Every record in this slice has system gbnag, and every record but Togo has independent false: no record in the slice is marked independent true.
claims.note: Togo has no independent key at all; see its own claim.

claims.statement: Fourteen countries in this slice belong to the GBNAG_SPS_EX block: Germany, Norway, France, Portugal, Italy, Netherlands (the), Finland, Iceland, Ireland, Belgium, Luxembourg, Estonia, Croatia and Romania. The other 69 records have an empty blocks list.

Only France and Portugal carry subdivisions in this slice: six for France and two for Portugal, each with an id under schemeId MDM-COUNTRY-SUBDIVISION and schemeAgencyId DEFRA. Every other record has an empty subDivisions list.
